basic_details.job_title: KMB Port Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala Maritime Board (KMB), through the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, is inviting online applications for one Port Officer post on contract basis, with a monthly consolidated pay of Rs.1,40,000/- including perks (TA/DA and official transportation). Applicants need a Foreign Going Master's Certificate (GoI or equivalent) with one year of command experience, or must be an Indian Navy officer not below Lieutenant Commander (Executive Branch) with Master (Foreign Going) certificate of service, not on the active list. Applications are accepted on www.cmd.kerala.gov.i

how_to_apply: Applications are made online through the website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram (www.cmd.kerala.gov.in). The window runs from 27 November 2026 (10:00 A.M.) to 6 December 2026 (05:00 P.M.). The notice asks applicants to fill all relevant fields of the online application and to read the detailed notification before applying.
Latest photograph, scanned, less than 200 kB, *.JPG format only.
Signature on white paper, scanned, less than 50 kB, *.JPG format only. It must be the full signature of the candidate; initials and signature in CAPITAL LETTERS are not permitted.
Valid certificates and supporting documents as proof of qualification and experience.
Equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority, where the qualification is an equivalent one.

Educational qualification: the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority. Mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets or statements are not accepted and such applications are rejected.

Experience: certificates must carry date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorised person. Appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in place of an experience certificate. An affidavit with employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities may be uploaded for the latest experience only.
Applicants need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the recruitment process is complete.
important_instructions: Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected, and information furnished later will not be entertained. If a lapse is found during scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected even if the candidate reaches the final stage or a later stage. If the details in the online form do not tally with the original documents produced, the candidature will be rejected. Applications with blurred or illegible photograph or signature, or ambiguous experience certificates, will be rejected. False or incorrect information found at any stage makes the candidature or appointment liable to be cancelled or terminated without notice. CMD may call for additional documentary evidence of qualification, experience or other notified eligibility requirements. CMD/KMB may modify or cancel the notification, revise the number of posts, or stop the recruitment process, without assigning any reason. CMD/KMB may debar a candidate for malpractice, including a fraudulent claim of any benefit, relaxation or concession, or for misconduct. KMB/CMD is not responsible for any discrepancy in submitting the online application.

content_sections.heading: About KMB
content_sections.text: The Kerala Maritime Board is a statutory board of the Government of Kerala. It was constituted under the Kerala Maritime Board Act 2017 by merging the establishments of the Directorate of Ports, Kerala State Maritime Development Corporation Limited and Kerala Maritime Society. This recruitment is conducted on behalf of KMB by the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Port Officer, with one vacancy. The qualification and experience are given as two alternatives: Foreign Going Master's Certificate (GoI or equivalent) with one year of command experience; or Indian Navy officer not below Lieutenant Commander (Executive Branch) with Master (Foreign Going) certificate of service, not on the active list. Preferred: one year or more of piloting and/or dredging experience. The upper age limit is 55 years, counted as on 27.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Applicants must be citizens of India. The qualification must be from a recognized University/Institute; applicants holding an equivalent qualification must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority, otherwise the application will not be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a monthly consolidated pay of Rs.1,40,000/- including perks (TA/DA and official transportation). The notice describes the position as contract basis; the contract period is not specified in the notice.

The notice asks applicants to fill all relevant fields of the online application and to read the detailed notification before applying. Educational qualification: the original certificate or the provisional certificate issued by a competent authority. Mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets or statements are not accepted and such applications are rejected. Experience: certificates must carry date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorised person. Appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in place of an experience certificate. An affidavit with employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks and responsibilities may be uploaded for the latest experience only. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: CMD reserves the right to decide the selection process based on requirements. The process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, a skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these methods. CMD may send intimation to download call letters for a written test, proficiency assessment or interview through the registered email ID. Only shortlisted candidates will receive intimation by email, SMS or phone call about the selection process. CMD/KMB also reserves the right to set the cut-off marks and shortlisting rules at all stages.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the KMB Port Officer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice shows one vacancy for the post of Port Officer, marked with an asterisk meaning the number may vary.

faq.answer: Apply online through the Centre for Management Development website, www.cmd.kerala.gov.in, uploading the photograph, signature and certificates the notice names.
